info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Estimates-v1-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Estimates Retrieval API provides a mechanism for accessing and listing utility billing estimates efficiently. This endpoint allows businesses to retrieve accurate estimates based on historical data, ensuring that users can plan their finances accordingly. Typical consumers include utility companies and financial analysts who require this data for budgeting and forecasting purposes. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their billing processes with timely estimates, improving service delivery and customer satisfaction.

get.description: Fetches an estimated billing amount based on the provided criteria. This endpoint allows users to understand potential costs associated with services before making a commitment.

requestBody.description: Request body for generating a billing estimate. The body should contain the necessary parameters for the estimate calculation.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the GET operation related to billing estimates.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesResponse_200.title: Billing Estimate Response

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the billing estimate.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the billing request.

state.description: The current state of the billing estimate.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the response.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesResponse_200.description: Represents the response structure for a successful billing estimate operation.

automated.description: Indicates whether the request was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Contains audit information related to the billing estimate request.
